faqs.a:
The contributions of a member to the police pension fund shall be 8.05 percent of
               the compensation paid him by the city. The person responsible for making up the payroll
               shall cause the contributions provided for in this section to be deducted from the
               compensation of each member on each payroll, for each payroll period, beginning with
               employment as a police officer and continuing so long as the police officer remains
               an active member. When deducted, each of such amounts shall be paid into the police
               pension fund and shall be credited to the individual account of the member from whose
               compensation such deductions were made.
(Code 1960, § 19-18(B); Code 1981, § 26-7)
